summary: Implemented Lambda and Lambdad (plus LambdaD/LambdaDict aliases) in monai/transforms/utility/array.py and dictionary.py, added docs entries in docs/source/transforms.rst, and added tests/test_lambda.py and tests/test_lambdad.py. Tests, flake8 and black were not run, per instructions; a diff check showed one removed line (the typing import, replaced to add Callable) and no lines over 120 characters. Nothing was committed. Open items: the docs reference a SplitChannel section with no matching class in array.py, and the spec's "only the typing import may be removed" was read as replacing that line to add Callable.
